req_desc: The public portfolio is delivered as a continuously rendered world rather than as a document ...
A visitor opens the world without signing in ...
Signing in at `POST /api/auth/login` with `owner@example.com` plus `deku-demo-pw-2026` returns an `access_token` ...
An owner request carrying no token, an expired token, a malformed token is denied with the targeted state unchanged
Passwords are stored hashed, never in plain text ...
An unpublished project is absent from the world manifest at `GET /api/world` ...
Publishing a project whose world coordinates match an already published project is rejected with the error code `coordinates_occupied` ...
A refused project stays a draft with an empty published timestamp ...
A direct call to the publish endpoint is refused the same way a studio control would be, so hiding a control does not satisfy the rule
Unpublishing removes the project from the world, from the text route, freeing the coordinates for a different draft
Publishing a project with no poster image is rejected as invalid with the error code `poster_required`
Poster bytes live in the object store under the key scheme `projects/{project_id}/posters/{sha256_of_bytes}.{ext}` ...
A published project poster is readable through the streaming endpoint by any request ...
Uploading one file twice for one project produces one stored object, one row ...
Project order is walked from the adjacency relation, never derived from a date field
The text route lists published projects only, in adjacency order ...
Exactly one consumer owns the keyboard at any moment, named on the root element
A whisper submission that fills the unlabelled decoy field is refused, writing nothing ...
A first-time visitor is asked once about non-essential measurement, the answer stored under `cookie-choice`, surviving a reload
Every public page view is recorded with its route plus the moment, readable by the owner alone
A lap whose checkpoint splits do not sum to its stated duration is refused, recording nothing
The daily board holds the fastest lap per visitor for the current UTC day
The world stays fully explorable when the shared endpoints are unreachable, with no feature hidden ...
Achievement progress survives a reload, held under browser keys tied to no account
Both achievement progress modes work: counting occurrences, collecting a distinct named group
The map is a top-down view of the world rendered at the moment of asking, never an authored picture
A whisper with an empty message, a missing country code, a message over the stated limit is rejected as invalid, writing nothing
A request for a studio route without a valid session goes to the sign-in route, continuing afterwards to the route originally asked for ...
Publishing lands the browser on a full confirmation page naming the project, naming its coordinates
A refused publish returns to the editing panel with the reason stated, nothing written
Writing a project opens a panel sliding in from the right edge over the list, the list staying visible behind
Every list carries an empty state saying what would be there
The interface reads as a hairline drawing over a rendered scene, never as filled cards competing with the scene ...
The server renders the HTML for every address, so the browser receives a rendered document on first paint ...
Eleven tables exist, with all timestamps in UTC ...
A project row carries a unique slug, a title, a summary, a link, three world coordinates, a zone, two adjacency fields, a published flag, a published timestamp ...
A project image row holds the object key, never the bytes
At most 30 whisper rows exist, with at most one row per visitor identifier
Four projects are seeded: `Lantern Run`, `Paper Tide`, `Copper Garden` published, `Night Ferry` held as a draft ...
The type scale is carried exactly, stepping as a set against a root size
Every appearance uses the two-phase display-then-visible sequence, so nothing arrives without its fade
Nothing scrolls the document itself, so the only scrolling regions sit inside panels
Loading progress is an arc closing into an ellipse, carrying no percentage, no bar, no word ...
Two stacked triggers sit at the right edge, absent until the visitor has started
Six menu contents live behind one shell, so switching never remounts the shell ...
A map location label reveals on hover with a pointer, standing permanently on a touch device
A locked reward is shown behind a scrim rather than hidden
An empty daily board shows one stated line rather than an empty table
The whisper submit control starts visibly inert, lighting up only once the message can be sent
The document title is `Marek's`, the description is `Marek Vance's creative portfolio`
No visitor account exists, no signup exists, no password reset exists for anyone ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
`GET /api/world` returns the published projects together with the areas as one object ...
Poster bytes exist as real objects in the MinIO bucket at their scheme key ...
core asks covered by this grader
